summary: No holding's thesis broke on news today. There were no fills, no stop tripped, and no held name had a new 8-K, 10-Q or 10-K. The only filings in the 7-day window on held names are the ones already handled: WMT 5.02/9.01 on 11-16, matched to the Joe Creed board appointment by inference; MCO 8.01/9.01 on 11-13, inferred to be a notes offering; INCY 8.01 on 11-13, MAESTRA-3 dropped with guidance kept; and SAM 8.01 on 11-13, still unread. No 4.01, 4.02 or 5.02 departure showed up on any holding. The tape was quiet for the book. The real risks are mechanical and dated. VOO and VTI closed with SPY at 730.20, only 0.06% above the 729.79 200-day line they share, so one weak close sells about 23% of equity. WMT reports tomorrow, 11-19, on a company-confirmed date. Today's input has no Nvidia headline, so the reaction to the 11-17 print still cannot be read from news. Per L2, I checked every held name's own earnings estimate and filings rather than relying on silence. Every date below comes from the events block and is not inferred from a missing headline.
